description: Runs one Etsy search (first 100 active listings, relevance order) and returns the shops behind it: how many of those listings each shop has, Etsy's shop sales count and opening year. Use for 'who sells <product> on Etsy?' and 'who are my competitors?'.

physical.description: Drop digital downloads/patterns from the results

query.description: What the seller sells, e.g. 'ceramic mug'

name: etsy_top_shops
title: Shops behind an Etsy search
